name: Universal ID type
citation: HL7au ADRM-2021.1 sec 3.14 HD, HL7 Table 0301 - Universal ID type (p. 161). The ADRM adds AUSHICPR, AUSHIC, AUSDVA, AUSNATA and AUSLSPN, each marked with a dagger as an Australian extension, and prints L, M and N as separate rows.
